findings.title: Required original lifecycle state has no complete typed persistence/preparation contract
findings.observed: The sole named persistence seam is status.deliveryPolicyEpoch. Its additionalProperties:false schema has only schemaVersion/leaseIdentity/policyConfig/initialTTL/authoritySnapshot/runtimeAuthority, whereas the required tuple includes evolving resource/exposure fences, Ready state, Product receipts, and cleanup ID/start/deadline/UID-preconditions/uncertainty. Cleanup exists only in fixture storedLifecycle.cleanup outside the typed epoch; adding it to epoch is rejected. No alternative physical status member/schema/CAS contract is defined. The six fixtures advertise complete state, but Ready summaries lack current demoReadiness state/requestId/namespace/runId/source/candidate/decision/result/image/manifest/credential/secret/url/exposure/receipt members. Product summary omits action:extend, which current productDeadline explicitly ignores. Epoch-only 18 controls do not validate these lifecycle states.
findings.consequence: The promised A cleanup deadline and Ready/Product migration/recovery cases cannot yet be prepared unambiguously from these complete-fixture claims. This is a local definition/fixture gap, not a demand for future target implementation or authentic grants now.
findings.requiredCorrection: Name and type the physical mutable original-lifecycle member(s), retained authority relations, UID/RV CAS/readback/uncertainty transitions before DELETE and after Ready/Product effects, and exact restart lookup. Preserve old fixtures as templates if intended; define deterministic full native lease/spec/status/request/receipt preparation with dependent byte/hash identities before baseline/effects. Include full Ready legacy/v2 and linked Product action/readyDigest/leaseUID receipt states, not arithmetic summaries. Add schema/state-shape contradiction negatives plus restored positives; retain genuine archive/grant/parent carrier prerequisites OPEN.

findings.title: Timestamp rebasing cannot preserve original raw digests and signed receipt identity
findings.observed: timestampScope requires shifting all fixture times by one offset while preserving relative deadlines/digests/receipt identity. Ready requestDigest hashes exact raw body, including observedAt. Product issuer issuedAt/expiresAt are in the exact raw signed payload under kubeclaw.demo-product-decision.v1\x00. Reviewer pure SHA/Ed25519 controls show timestamp shift changes Ready digest and causes original Product signature rejection; the original payload signature remains valid as positive control.
findings.consequence: The future fixture factory is required to preserve an impossible byte identity, or would secretly alter signed original authority. Freezing newly generated bytes after an unspecified shift does not resolve which original receipt/digest is authoritative.
findings.requiredCorrection: Separate synthetic template instantiation from retained authentic A history. For new synthetic A baseline, choose trusted T0 once, instantiate all times and dependent raw request/spec/payload digests, test-owned issuer signatures and linked receipt identities, and freeze complete generated bytes/provenance before original admission/effects. Never rebase or re-sign already admitted/archived A with B/latest. Alternatively define a precise future clock seam without mutating signed original bytes. Add exact shifted-byte rejection and original-byte positive definition cases. No native clock or authentic issuer execution required at C0.

findings.title: Exact principal domain is not enforced by the declared own definition gate
findings.observed: The target domain requires exact system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<name>, separate Ready/Product principals, and actual DNS/TokenReview/UID/grants. The own strict schema only uses type:string for both principal projections. Running its actual correlations on schema-accepted A mutations accepts empty Ready producer and Product producer not-a-serviceaccount. Both contradict even current static Go four-part/name preflight. This does not establish any live authentication weakness or invalidate correctly shaped A/B specimens.
findings.consequence: The pure exact proposal gate gives false positives for known static domain violations; 111 pure passes cannot establish full supported domain validation.
findings.requiredCorrection: Align the own proposal schema/correlation guard with the known static projection grammar and target source namespace/name relation, with explicit invalid/missing/empty/length/character and restored controls. Keep actual UID/TokenReview/grant authenticity explicitly future. If the gate is intentionally partial, mark that precise limitation machine-readably and supply exact delegated pre-effect parser/domain case oracles rather than describing only exact shape/types.
